answer: Because the vine count is verified against the beacon text itself, the reef audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 31 aliases hence means producing 31 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
